taskDescription: Arrange these stages of haem degradation in the correct order, from red cell destruction to faecal pigment.

sequenceImages.imageDescription: Macrophage destroying an aged red blood cell and releasing haem
Haem oxygenase opening the porphyrin ring to form green biliverdin
Biliverdin reduced to yellow unconjugated bilirubin carried on albumin
Hepatocyte conjugating bilirubin with glucuronic acid for bile secretion
Intestinal bilirubin metabolism through urobilinogen to brown stercobilin

l10n.score: You got @score of @total points. Macrophages degrade haem through biliverdin to unconjugated bilirubin. Albumin transports bilirubin to the liver for conjugation and biliary secretion. Intestinal bacteria form urobilinogen, most of which becomes stercobilin.
